versions.content: Safety Requirements distinguishable Type: valid Description: Safety requirements shall be distinguishable from other requirements in AUTOSAR models Rationale: Regulations of safety standards need to be applied solely to safety requirements. This holds e.g. for the traceability or ASIL dependent measures or constraints. It is therefore necessary to clearly identify the safety requirements. Use Case: [UC_SAFEX_00001], [UC_SAFEX_00002] Dependencies: [RS_SAFEX_00001] Supporting Material: see ISO 26262-8 [1].
